Welcome to the new BiblicalLeadership.com — A Note from Tom Harper, Founder

June 16, 2026By Tom Harper
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:50
Instaread

Welcome! If you’ve been a subscriber of BiblicalLeadership.com for any length of time, you know our writers bless us with great content that helps us all become better, more Christ-like leaders.

I’ve been planning to redesign this site for a while (like years). You’ll notice it now has a much greater focus on the newsletter.

This one change is driving everything else on the site. Most of the posts you’ll click on in the newsletter will take you directly to our partner’s own websites. You can just return to the newsletter in your inbox to read the next article.

Rather than continuing to build our archives (which we’ve done for 15+ years), we wanted to rethink our purpose. It’s not just to house helpful articles; it’s to help marketplace and ministry leaders apply biblical wisdom to level-up their leadership, glorify God and get bottom-line results.

We can do this more easily (and affordably) by curating content into a flexible newsletter format. The site becomes the subscription engine; the newsletters themselves become collections of the best leadership content and resources we can find. Every issue will be housed on the site in a searchable format, so you never have to worry about losing track of your favorite reads.

Our goal is to multiply our content by 10X, and to focus it more sharply for you. We’re in the process of onboarding new ministries, authors, conferences, podcasters and creators that fit into our mission.

Thank you for being a subscriber. If this is your first visit, welcome!

Feel free to reach out to me on LinkedIn with any questions or just to connect.

Blessings,
Tom

P.S. Thank you for your patience as you encounter glitches (I know you will!). We’ll be working throughout the coming weeks and months to give everything a good polish.
